expected_rate: on every Track A entry attempt (a geometry line, an unavailable line, or a one-share cap line); Track A has entered on most sessions since 2026-09-15
window_reason: Track A does not fire every session; three sessions covers the observed entry cadence (44 Day entries over 22 sessions, 9/15-10/27).
reversal: a Track A entry wires 0 shares or is skipped because of the wider stop; a stop tighter than the room stop; more shares than the existing rule; or, over the next 20 Track A trades, P&L from fills worse than the today-rule counterfactual or a target-hit rate below the trades' own room / (room + target) break-even (design record Q9)
